[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 18]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the First Amendment to Contract DA-5696 with Monument ROW: To extend the term by two (2) years, for new expiration date of February 6, 2029, covering real estate consulting, acquisition, and right-of-way services for Los Angeles World Airports (Jean-Pierre Tabet)
summary: Extension of real estate consulting and right-of-way services contract with Monument ROW for Los Angeles World Airports through February 2029.
